name: Chris Draper

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story residence with a light-colored roof and an adjacent green-roofed RV/camper carport as well as a small shed|A green fenced yard area is attached to the main house|A dirt and gravel driveway leads from the road to the structures|The surrounding terrain is open with scattered small trees and shrubs|The site has a rural character with clear space around the buildings.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows the single-story residence with a light-colored roof and the green-roofed shed and RV trailer covered parking spot nearby|A dirt driveway provides access from the road to the house and parking area|Open terrain with scattered trees and shrubs surrounds the structures|The green fenced yard is visible adjacent to the main residence.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the main residence and green-roofed shed and covered RV parking place set within open terrain|A patio is located directly behind the residence|Scattered small trees and shrubs are present across the lot|The dirt driveway and parking area near the buildings are visible|The property has open space extending outward from the structures.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the back of the main residence and the green fenced yard area|Open terrain with scattered trees and shrubs extends behind the structures|Windows and a sliding glass door lines the back facade of the residence|The green-roofed shed and covered parking spot is visible from this angle|The lot remains largely open with scattered vegetation.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the main residence, one large window on this side of the house, a green-roofed shed and covered RV parking spot, and surrounding open terrain|Scattered small trees and shrubs are distributed across the lot|The dirt driveway approaches the structures from the road|The site maintains clear space and visibility around the buildings.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a dirt and gravel driveway leading from street to the main residence and small structures. The open terrain surrounding the structures provides good space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. Scattered small trees and shrubs are present but do not create dense cover. The green fenced yard is attached to the main house. Overall access and visibility are good due to the open rural setting.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property or the fenced yard area? Is vehicle access available around all sides of the main residence and outbuilding?
